product_family: Legal AI platform for law firms and in-house counsel, including document analysis, legal research, contract intelligence, and AI agents for complex legal workflows. Serves 142,000+ professionals across 60+ AmLaw 100 firms.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Harvey undergoes annual SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 audits to validate these controls. Harvey has successfully completed another SOC 2 Type II audit conducted by Schellman.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Harvey has successfully completed another SOC 2 Type II audit and renewed our ISO 27001 certification. Schellman conducted the independent assessments.

certifications.name: ISO 27701
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27701 listed among current certifications available in trust portal.

certifications.name: ISO 42001 (AI Management Systems)
certifications.proof_quote: Harvey has achieved ISO 42001 certification, the leading internationally recognized standard specifically designed for AI management systems. Announced June 5, 2026.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Harvey implements Data Privacy Framework for EEA/UK/Switzerland transfers and Standard Contractual Clauses for non-adequate jurisdictions. Enforceable commitments built to exceed standard vendor terms aligned with GDPR standards.

certifications.name: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act)
certifications.proof_quote: Data Processing Addendum covers compliance with California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Customer data retention and processing governed by separate customer agreements.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA certification on vendor domain. Healthcare use cases mentioned for compliance advisory work, but HIPAA compliance not explicitly claimed or certified.

certifications.name: IRAP (Australian Compliance)
certifications.proof_quote: IRAP listed among available certifications in trust portal.

certifications.name: WCAG 2.2 AA (Accessibility)
certifications.proof_quote: WCAG 2.2 AA compliance listed in certifications available through trust portal.

privacy.ai_training_note: Harvey contractually guarantees through Platform Agreement that it does not use inputs, outputs, or uploaded documents to train underlying models. Harvey does use publicly available information (court judgments, decisions, public filings) to develop and train AI systems. This is covered in Privacy Policy which excludes uploaded platform data from the general privacy policy, governing it instead through Customer Agreements.
privacy.data_region: Flexible - US (default), EU, Switzerland, Australia. Customers specify preferred region in order forms.

security.name: Encryption Key Management
security.value: Annual key rotation with hardware security module protection

security.name: Access Controls
security.value: Multi-factor authentication, unique IDs, strong passwords, least-privilege access. Staff cannot access customer data without service necessity or legal order.

security.name: Vulnerability Management
security.value: Critical vulnerabilities patched within 7 days, high-severity within 30 days, medium within 90 days. Annual penetration tests and web application security assessments.

security.name: Threat Detection
security.value: Industry-standard threat detection with daily signature updates. Daily monitoring and annual penetration testing.

security.name: Personnel Security
security.value: Mandatory security training at onboarding and annually. Background checks include ID verification, work authorization, and criminal history screening.

security.name: Incident Response
security.value: Customer notification within 48 hours of confirmed breach. Full investigation and mitigation details provided. Logs preserved minimum 1 year.

security.name: Third-Party Auditors
security.value: Partners with Schellman, NCC Group, and Bishop Fox for annual audits and penetration tests.

security.name: Data Lifecycle Management
security.value: Matter-level access controls, audit-ready logs, customer ability to delete data anytime, 30-day deletion window upon service termination request.

security.name: Audit Rights
security.value: Customers receive annual audit reports at no cost. Can submit security questionnaires (up to 100 questions). May request audits per Security Addendum terms.

security.name: Data Transfer Framework
security.value: Data Privacy Framework certified for EU/UK/Switzerland transfers. Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) for non-adequate jurisdictions.

products.name: Harvey Assistant

products.notes: Ask questions, analyze documents, draft faster with domain-specific AI

products.notes: Securely store, organize, and bulk-analyze legal documents with encryption and access controls

products.notes: Research complex legal, regulatory, and tax questions. Covers common and civil law systems across US, UK, EU, APAC, MENA

products.name: Harvey Agents
products.data_scope: 500+ pre-built and custom agents for legal workflows
products.notes: Purpose-built agents execute complex legal work end-to-end across practice areas (capital markets, environmental law, bankruptcy, etc.). Vetted by in-house lawyers.

products.name: Contract Intelligence
products.data_scope: Contract extraction, analysis, and risk identification
products.notes: Surface insights, strengthen negotiations, and accelerate contract reviews

products.name: Harvey Mobile
products.notes: Get up to speed, capture information, and keep work moving from anywhere

products.name: Command Center
products.data_scope: Firm-wide AI adoption analytics and benchmarking
products.notes: Analytics, benchmarking, and agentic insights for organizational AI transformation leadership

products.name: Shared Spaces
products.notes: Work with legal teams across organizations in secure, shared spaces

compare.pricing_model: Enterprise SaaS subscription; per-user or per-team models available. Pricing not publicly listed; contact for quote.
compare.data_residency: Multi-region: US (default), EU, Switzerland, Australia. Customers specify region; alternative requests honored where technically feasible.

flags: HIPAA not claimed or certified despite healthcare use cases being mentioned. Vendor positions platform for legal work, not healthcare directly.
ISO 42001 certification very recent (June 5, 2026). Newest addition to compliance portfolio.

Trust center documents (SOC 2, ISO reports) appear to require customer access/verification through SafeBase portal; full audit details not freely public but vendor states documents available to customers.
Privacy policy notes customer-uploaded data excluded from general privacy policy, governed instead by Customer Agreements. Standard for SaaS but worth noting.
Web browsing feature (you.com integration) noted as non-HIPAA compliant, but Harvey platform itself does not claim HIPAA.
